reply_text:
One merge blocker:

*`src/plans.js:11` — quota conversion makes team and archive quotas zero.* JavaScript’s `<<` coerces values to signed 32-bit integers, so `entry.quotaKiB << 10` returns `0` for both plans instead of 200 GiB and 2 TiB. I reproduced a 1-byte upload being rejected on an empty account for each.

Use multiplication by `1024` rather than a bit shift, and add quota/upload tests for both paid plans before merging.

All 4 existing tests pass; they only exercise free-plan quota enforcement. No code changed.
